For [filters](/docs/shell/commands/categories/filters/).

<div class='command-title'>Multiply all elements of a matrix by a scalar.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> matrix scale {flags} (scalar)```

## Parameters

 -  `scalar`: The scalar to multiply each element by.


## Input/output types:

| input  | output |
| ------ | ------ |
| matrix | matrix |
## Examples

Scale a matrix by an integer
```nu
> matrix identity 2 | matrix scale 3 | matrix into-nu | to nuon
[[3.0, 0.0], [0.0, 3.0]]
```

Scale a matrix by a float
```nu
> matrix identity 2 | matrix scale 0.5 | matrix into-nu | to nuon
[[0.5, 0.0], [0.0, 0.5]]
```
